text: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of the original purchase. After 30 days, prepaid subscription fees are non-refundable.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every administrator account. Standard member accounts may enable MFA optionally.
Enterprise support has a two-hour initial response SLA, 24 hours a day and seven days a week.
Uploaded customer documents are encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2 or newer in transit.
When a workspace is deleted, its customer data is permanently removed from active systems within seven days.
The public API allows 120 requests per minute per workspace. Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429.
AI agents can perform read-only lookups automatically. Destructive actions require explicit human approval before execution.
Annual subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Cancellation stops the next renewal but does not override the 30-day refund policy.
